ApexAi builds guarded web-data and business communications products with operator, API, and agent interfaces. **Scrawl** turns web sources into owned artifacts and versioned datasets, with crawling built on Scrapy. **Communications** runs customer support and business messaging on your own Twilio, SendGrid, and Telegram accounts, with consent and history built in and the AI provider of your choice, or none.

Each product owns its rules. A person working in Telegram, an application calling ApexAPI, and an AI agent using ApexMCP all pass the same product policy before anything runs, and all get evidence back.

<a href="https://apexaiofficial.com/scrawl"><picture><source media="(max-width: 640px)" srcset="assets/scrawl-narrow.svg"><img src="assets/scrawl.svg" width="100%" alt="Scrawl, web-data operations: turn web sources into owned artifacts and versioned datasets. Workflow from source to dataset: choose a cataloged source, pass the policy and egress gate, crawl, fetch, or render, classify and store artifacts, publish a dataset version, then search and fetch records."></picture></a>

<a href="https://apexaiofficial.com/communications"><picture><source media="(max-width: 640px)" srcset="assets/communications-narrow.svg"><img src="assets/communications.svg" width="100%" alt="Communications, customer support and business messaging: customer conversations on your own provider accounts, with consent, history, and your choice of AI. Workflow for a support conversation: the customer writes in, the conversation opens or reopens, a person, automation, or allowed AI answers, the consent and Trust and Safety gate, the reply goes out from the number they wrote to, then the reply and its provenance are kept in history."></picture></a>
